summary.text: Ingrid Wadsworth is the Democratic candidate for the Florida House of Representatives, District 3, in the November 3, 2026 general election, against Republican incumbent Nathan Boyles.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she described herself as a microbiologist, mother, grandmother, Air Force widow, and executive with more than 30 years of leadership experience.

paragraphs.text: Wadsworth earned a bachelor's degree from Northern Illinois University in 1988, according to Ballotpedia, which lists her career experience as an executive.
In a Ballotpedia survey, Wadsworth named affordability, including food, insurance, and housing costs, as a key campaign message and said her background includes work on insurance systems.
She also listed protecting agriculture and rural lands in Santa Rosa and Okaloosa Counties and supporting military families and veterans, including protecting the VA from privatization.
She said she has worked throughout her career to open doors for women and underrepresented voices.
